author: Lucifist
body:
It's been a wonderful 4 years, and I'm extremely grateful for having the opportunity to serve this server as a Moderator. I guess all good things come to an end. I might pop on sometimes, but that's unlikely. I won't name people on this thread because of the obvious reasons. Anyways peace 












Rip
